# O.G. Nails by Olga

> Nail studio in Ballantyne, Charlotte, North Carolina, run by nail specialist Olga Glavatcaia. Advanced dry (Russian / e-file) manicures, dry pedicures, advanced pedicure and foot care (cracked heels, calluses, corns, thick toenails, titanium wire correction for early ingrown toenails) and hard gel extensions. Appointments are one-on-one and booked online through Vagaro.

## Key facts
- Address: 5107 Piper Station Dr, Suite C, Charlotte, NC 28277 (Ballantyne), inside SES Style Salon
- Serves: Ballantyne, Charlotte, Pineville, SouthPark, Weddington, Matthews and Marvin
- Booking: https://www.vagaro.com/ognails (by appointment only)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/o.g_nails
- Specialist: Olga Glavatcaia, nail specialist since 2017, NailPro World Cup 2020 3rd place, trained in titanium wire toenail correction (2026)
- Services for women and men
- We do not diagnose or treat fungal infections. If a medical condition is suspected, we recommend consulting a podiatrist.

## Prices (USD)
### Dry manicure
- Hygienic Manicure (No Polish): $70. Nail shaping, cuticle care and hand massage. No polish.
- Hygienic Manicure for Men (No Polish): $95. Meticulous shaping, cuticle care and hand massage. No polish.
- Manicure with Gel Polish / Strengthening: $120. Chip-resistant gel polish, with strengthening treatments to reduce breakage and support growth.
- Hand Spa Treatment: $30. Exfoliation and massage to nourish skin and relieve tension.
- Design / French: from $20. Nail art or a French finish, added to any polish service.

### Dry pedicure & advanced foot care
- Hygienic Pedicure (No Polish): $110. Nail trimming, cuticle care, dry e-file foot care, foot massage and moisturizer.
- Hygienic Pedicure for Men (No Polish): $120. Nail trimming, cuticle care, dry e-file foot care, foot massage and moisturizer.
- Pedicure with Gel Polish: $140. Nail trimming, cuticle care, dry e-file foot care, foot massage and moisturizer, finished with a long-lasting, high-gloss gel polish.
- Advanced Pedicure / Foot Care (No Polish): $160–$260. Addresses keratoses, cracks, excessive dryness and calluses. Price is based on the complexity of the case, in three levels: basic, moderate and complex. Complexity depends on the condition of the foot, not the nails.
- Deep Toenail Cleaning: $10–$30 per nail. Thorough cleaning of toenails affected by hematoma, fungus or onycholysis. Available as an add-on to the Advanced Pedicure only.
- Advanced Pedicure / Foot Care with Gel Polish: $180–$280. Advanced treatment plus gel polish, applied only when the natural nail plate is healthy and suitable.

### Hard gel & extensions
- Gel Fill: Short Nails: $140. Shapes your short natural nails with hard gel, for a natural look with the strength of hard gel.
- Gel Fill: Medium Nails: $160. Shapes your medium-length natural nails with hard gel, for a natural look with the strength of hard gel.
- Gel Fill: Long Nails: $180. Shapes your long natural nails with hard gel, for a natural look with the strength of hard gel.
- Nail Extension: Short / Medium: $200. Creates your desired short or medium length and nail shape.
- Nail Extension: Long: from $250. Creates your desired long length and nail shape.
- Design / French: from $20. Nail art or a French finish, added to any gel service.
- Sculpted Design / French: from $250. Custom sculpted nail designs or French tips built with hard gel for a clean, structured and long-lasting finish.
